import json,subprocess,sys,os
print(os.path.exists('/tmp/batch_orig.py'))
S=["normal","mixed","partial-zero","empty","unknown","fail-fast","cancelled","live"]
def run(path,s):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,path,s],input=b"\n",capture_output=True,timeout=10)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout,[json.loads(l) for l in p.stderr.decode().splitlines()]
base={s:run('/tmp/batch_orig.py',s) for s in S}
ok=True
def norm(r): r=dict(r); r.pop('elapsed_ms'); return r
for s in S:
    for rep in range(2):
        rc,out,err=run('/work/batch.py',s)
        brc,bout,berr=base[s]
        chk = rc==brc and out==bout and len(err)==len(berr) \
          and all(type(r['sequence']) is int and r['sequence']==i for i,r in enumerate(err)) \
          and all(list(r)[:-1]==list(b) and list(r)[-1]=='sequence' for r,b in zip(err,berr)) \
          and [{k:v for k,v in norm(r).items() if k!='sequence'} for r in err]==[norm(b) for b in berr]
        ok&=chk
    print(s,rc,[(r['event'],r['sequence']) for r in err],'OK' if chk else 'FAIL')
for p in ['/tmp/batch_orig.py','/work/batch.py']:
    d=subprocess.run([sys.executable,p],capture_output=True,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    b=subprocess.run([sys.executable,p,'bogus'],capture_output=True)
    l=subprocess.run([sys.executable,p,'live'],capture_output=True,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    print(p,'default rc',d.returncode,'stdout==normal',d.stdout==base['normal'][1],'| bogus rc',b.returncode,b.stderr.decode().splitlines()[-1],'| live/no-input rc',l.returncode,l.stderr.decode().splitlines()[-1])
print('ALL OK',ok)
